name: Dharma Gaia
tradition: Independent lay community inspired by Thich Nhat Hanh's teaching (not an official Plum Village center)
technique: Mindfulness practice, walking meditation, engaged Buddhism
retreatOptions: Day retreats up to a month-long Winter Retreat; self-directed personal retreats; 3-month internship
about: A Coromandel land-based community explicitly inspired by Thich Nhat Hanh, offering residential retreats -- including a full closed July Winter Retreat -- self-guided stays, and volunteering, with vegetarian/organic food on a sliding-scale contribution model. Currently the closest New Zealand approximation to a Plum Village-style center, though not an official EIAB/Plum Village entity.
schedule: Ongoing seasonal program, annual month-long winter retreat
workNotes: Volunteer track requires 4-5 hrs/day; less clear for formal retreat guests.
